## Meta-Analysis of Primary Results

In this analysis, I am doing the meta-analysis of the results from the prior experiment ('Batch 1' or 'B1') with the results from the new experiment ('Batch 2' or 'B2').  

The purpose of this study is to compare IDC to DCIS and DCIS High vs DCIS Low for each gene that appears in both protein batches based on Accession.GeneSymbol matching.  

A summary of the various genes can be found in the excel file "Protein_Meta_analysis_CS.xlsx". In this Excel file, there are separate tabs for analysis of Protein DCIS (combined) and IDC Batch 1 and 2 and Protein DCIS High and DCIS Low Batch 1 and 2. There are also tabs for meta analysis between the 2 batches for both DCIS vs IDC and DCIS High vs DCIS Low. The DCIS.CCR2high and DCIS.CCR2low groups are combined to a DCIS group for the DCIS vs IDC analysis, increasing the n from 3 to 6 for the DCIS group.  

For matching the gene names between the two batches, the results are:  

Matching Gene Count between the 2 batches = 2117  
Unique to Batch 1 = 302 (2419 total)  
Unique to Batch 2 = 1596 (3713 total)

```{r summary1, echo=FALSE}

data.trans.protein.DvI.B1 <- data.trans.protein.B1 |> filter(group != "Normal" & group != "Normal.Adj")
data.trans.protein.DvI.B1$group <- str_replace(data.trans.protein.DvI.B1$group,"DCIS.CCR2high","DCIS")
data.trans.protein.DvI.B1$group <- str_replace(data.trans.protein.DvI.B1$group,"DCIS.CCR2low","DCIS")
data.trans.protein.DvI.B2 <- data.trans.protein.B2
data.trans.protein.DvI.B2$group <- str_replace(data.trans.protein.DvI.B2$group,"DCIS.CCR2high","DCIS")
data.trans.protein.DvI.B2$group <- str_replace(data.trans.protein.DvI.B2$group,"DCIS.CCR2low","DCIS")

data.trans.protein.HvL.B1 <- data.trans.protein.B1 |> filter(group != "Normal" & group != "Normal.Adj" & group != "IDC")
data.trans.protein.HvL.B1$group <- as.factor(data.trans.protein.HvL.B1$group)
data.trans.protein.HvL.B1$group <- relevel(data.trans.protein.HvL.B1$group, ref = "DCIS.CCR2low")
data.trans.protein.HvL.B2 <- data.trans.protein.B2 |> filter(group != "IDC")
data.trans.protein.HvL.B2$group <- as.factor(data.trans.protein.HvL.B2$group)
data.trans.protein.HvL.B2$group <- relevel(data.trans.protein.HvL.B2$group, ref = "DCIS.CCR2low")


tmp.protein.DvI.B1<-describeBy(data.trans.protein.DvI.B1[,2:(n.protein.B1+1)], group=data.trans.protein.DvI.B1$group)
tmp.protein.DvI.B2<-describeBy(data.trans.protein.DvI.B2[,1:(n.protein.B2)], group=data.trans.protein.DvI.B2$group)

tmp.protein.HvL.B1<-describeBy(data.trans.protein.HvL.B1[,2:(n.protein.B1+1)], group=data.trans.protein.HvL.B1$group)
tmp.protein.HvL.B2<-describeBy(data.trans.protein.HvL.B2[,1:(n.protein.B2)], group=data.trans.protein.HvL.B2$group)

tmp1.protein.DvI.B1 <- data.frame(Gene=rownames(tmp.protein.DvI.B1[[1]]),
                         DCIS.n=tmp.protein.DvI.B1[[1]]$n,DCIS.mean=tmp.protein.DvI.B1[[1]]$mean,DCIS.sd=tmp.protein.DvI.B1[[1]]$sd,
                         IDC.n=tmp.protein.DvI.B1[[2]]$n,IDC.mean=tmp.protein.DvI.B1[[2]]$mean,IDC.sd=tmp.protein.DvI.B1[[2]]$sd)
tmp1.protein.DvI.B2 <- data.frame(Gene=rownames(tmp.protein.DvI.B2[[1]]),
                         DCIS.n=tmp.protein.DvI.B2[[1]]$n,DCIS.mean=tmp.protein.DvI.B2[[1]]$mean,DCIS.sd=tmp.protein.DvI.B2[[1]]$sd,
                         IDC.n=tmp.protein.DvI.B2[[2]]$n,IDC.mean=tmp.protein.DvI.B2[[2]]$mean,IDC.sd=tmp.protein.DvI.B2[[2]]$sd)

tmp1.protein.HvL.B1 <- data.frame(Gene=rownames(tmp.protein.HvL.B1[[1]]),
                         DCIS.Low.n=tmp.protein.HvL.B1[[1]]$n,DCIS.Low.mean=tmp.protein.HvL.B1[[1]]$mean,DCIS.Low.sd=tmp.protein.HvL.B1[[1]]$sd,
                         DCIS.High.n=tmp.protein.HvL.B1[[2]]$n,DCIS.High.mean=tmp.protein.HvL.B1[[2]]$mean,DCIS.High.sd=tmp.protein.HvL.B1[[2]]$sd)
tmp1.protein.HvL.B2 <- data.frame(Gene=rownames(tmp.protein.HvL.B2[[1]]),
                         DCIS.Low.n=tmp.protein.HvL.B2[[1]]$n,DCIS.Low.mean=tmp.protein.HvL.B2[[1]]$mean,DCIS.Low.sd=tmp.protein.HvL.B2[[1]]$sd,
                         DCIS.High.n=tmp.protein.HvL.B2[[2]]$n,DCIS.High.mean=tmp.protein.HvL.B2[[2]]$mean,DCIS.High.sd=tmp.protein.HvL.B2[[2]]$sd)


protein.LM.results.DvI.B1<-matrix(NA,nrow=n.protein.B1, ncol=4)
dimnames(protein.LM.results.DvI.B1)[[2]]<-c("Gene", "Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")
protein.LM.results.DvI.B2<-matrix(NA,nrow=n.protein.B2, ncol=4)
dimnames(protein.LM.results.DvI.B2)[[2]]<-c("Gene", "Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")

protein.LM.results.HvL.B1<-matrix(NA,nrow=n.protein.B1, ncol=4)
dimnames(protein.LM.results.HvL.B1)[[2]]<-c("Gene", "Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")
protein.LM.results.HvL.B2<-matrix(NA,nrow=n.protein.B2, ncol=4)
dimnames(protein.LM.results.HvL.B2)[[2]]<-c("Gene", "Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")

for(i in 1:n.protein.B1){
  fit1.protein.DvI.B1<-lm(data.trans.protein.DvI.B1[,i+1]~as.factor(data.trans.protein.DvI.B1$group))
  fit2.protein.DvI.B1<-summary(fit1.protein.DvI.B1)
  
  protein.LM.results.DvI.B1[i,1]<-dimnames(data.trans.protein.DvI.B1)[[2]][i+1]
  protein.LM.results.DvI.B1[i,2]<-coef(fit1.protein.DvI.B1)[2]
  protein.LM.results.DvI.B1[i,3]<-fit2.protein.DvI.B1$coefficients[,"Std. Error"][2]
  protein.LM.results.DvI.B1[i,4]<-round(fit2.protein.DvI.B1$coefficients[2,'Pr(>|t|)'], 4)
  
  fit1.protein.HvL.B1<-lm(data.trans.protein.HvL.B1[,i+1]~as.factor(data.trans.protein.HvL.B1$group))
  fit2.protein.HvL.B1<-summary(fit1.protein.HvL.B1)
  
  protein.LM.results.HvL.B1[i,1]<-dimnames(data.trans.protein.HvL.B1)[[2]][i+1]
  protein.LM.results.HvL.B1[i,2]<-coef(fit1.protein.HvL.B1)[2]
  protein.LM.results.HvL.B1[i,3]<-fit2.protein.HvL.B1$coefficients[,"Std. Error"][2]
  protein.LM.results.HvL.B1[i,4]<-round(fit2.protein.HvL.B1$coefficients[2,'Pr(>|t|)'], 4)
}

for(i in 1:n.protein.B2){
  fit1.protein.DvI.B2<-lm(data.trans.protein.DvI.B2[,i]~as.factor(data.trans.protein.DvI.B2$group))
  fit2.protein.DvI.B2<-summary(fit1.protein.DvI.B2)
  
  protein.LM.results.DvI.B2[i,1]<-dimnames(data.trans.protein.DvI.B2)[[2]][i]
  protein.LM.results.DvI.B2[i,2]<-coef(fit1.protein.DvI.B2)[2]
  protein.LM.results.DvI.B2[i,3]<-fit2.protein.DvI.B2$coefficients[,"Std. Error"][2]
  protein.LM.results.DvI.B2[i,4]<-round(fit2.protein.DvI.B2$coefficients[2,'Pr(>|t|)'], 4)
  
  fit1.protein.HvL.B2<-lm(data.trans.protein.HvL.B2[,i]~as.factor(data.trans.protein.HvL.B2$group))
  fit2.protein.HvL.B2<-summary(fit1.protein.HvL.B2)
  
  protein.LM.results.HvL.B2[i,1]<-dimnames(data.trans.protein.HvL.B2)[[2]][i]
  protein.LM.results.HvL.B2[i,2]<-coef(fit1.protein.HvL.B2)[2]
  protein.LM.results.HvL.B2[i,3]<-fit2.protein.HvL.B2$coefficients[,"Std. Error"][2]
  protein.LM.results.HvL.B2[i,4]<-round(fit2.protein.HvL.B2$coefficients[2,'Pr(>|t|)'], 4)
}

protein.LM.results.DvI.B1 <- as.data.frame(protein.LM.results.DvI.B1)
protein.LM.results.DvI.B2 <- as.data.frame(protein.LM.results.DvI.B2)
protein.LM.results.HvL.B1 <- as.data.frame(protein.LM.results.HvL.B1)
protein.LM.results.HvL.B2 <- as.data.frame(protein.LM.results.HvL.B2)

conv_cols <- c("Beta", "SE_Beta","T.Test.P.Value")

protein.LM.results.DvI.B1[conv_cols] <- lapply(protein.LM.results.DvI.B1[conv_cols], as.numeric)
protein.LM.results.DvI.B2[conv_cols] <- lapply(protein.LM.results.DvI.B2[conv_cols], as.numeric)
protein.LM.results.HvL.B1[conv_cols] <- lapply(protein.LM.results.HvL.B1[conv_cols], as.numeric)
protein.LM.results.HvL.B2[conv_cols] <- lapply(protein.LM.results.HvL.B2[conv_cols], as.numeric)

protein.results.DvI.B1 <- inner_join(protein.LM.results.DvI.B1,tmp1.protein.DvI.B1,by="Gene")
protein.results.DvI.B2 <- inner_join(protein.LM.results.DvI.B2,tmp1.protein.DvI.B2,by="Gene")
protein.results.HvL.B1 <- inner_join(protein.LM.results.HvL.B1,tmp1.protein.HvL.B1,by="Gene")
protein.results.HvL.B2 <- inner_join(protein.LM.results.HvL.B2,tmp1.protein.HvL.B2,by="Gene")


remove(tmp.protein.DvI.B1,tmp1.protein.DvI.B1,fit1.protein.DvI.B1,fit2.protein.DvI.B1,
       tmp.protein.HvL.B1,tmp1.protein.HvL.B1,fit1.protein.HvL.B1,fit2.protein.HvL.B1,
       tmp.protein.DvI.B2,tmp1.protein.DvI.B2,fit1.protein.DvI.B2,fit2.protein.DvI.B2,
       tmp.protein.HvL.B2,tmp1.protein.HvL.B2,fit1.protein.HvL.B2,fit2.protein.HvL.B2,
       conv_cols,i)
```

## Analysis for top genes in both analyses

DCIS vs. IDC  
Count for FDR < 0.01 = 1  
Count for FDR < 0.05 = 3  
Count for FDR < 0.1 = 5  

DCIS Low vs. DCIS High  
Count for FDR < 0.01 = 151  
Count for FDR < 0.05 = 270  
Count for FDR < 0.1 = 371  



```{r meta_beta, echo=FALSE}

fdr_thresh_DvI <- 0.1

protein.results.gene.combine.DvI.temp <- inner_join(protein.results.DvI.B1,protein.results.DvI.B2,by="Gene")
protein.results.gene.combine.DvI <- protein.results.gene.combine.DvI.temp |>
  select(Gene,Beta.x,SE_Beta.x,Beta.y,SE_Beta.y)
n.gene.protein.DvI <- dim(protein.results.gene.combine.DvI)[1]

protein.meta.analysis.list.DvI <- list()
protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI <- matrix(NA,nrow = n.gene.protein.DvI,ncol = 6)
dimnames(protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI)[[2]] <- c("Gene","Estimate","SE","Lower.CI","Upper.CI","p.value")
protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[,1] <- protein.results.gene.combine.DvI$Gene
for(j in 1:n.gene.protein.DvI){
  y <- c(protein.results.gene.combine.DvI$Beta.x[j],protein.results.gene.combine.DvI$Beta.y[j])
  se <- c(protein.results.gene.combine.DvI$SE_Beta.x[j],protein.results.gene.combine.DvI$SE_Beta.y[j])
  meta.res.protein.DvI <- rma(yi = y, sei = se,method = "FE")
  protein.meta.analysis.list.DvI[[j]] <- meta.res.protein.DvI
  protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,2] <- meta.res.protein.DvI$beta[1]
  protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,3] <- meta.res.protein.DvI$se
  protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,4] <- meta.res.protein.DvI$ci.lb
  protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,5] <- meta.res.protein.DvI$ci.ub
  protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[j,6] <- meta.res.protein.DvI$pval
}
protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI <- as.data.frame(protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI)

fit.protein.DvI<-multtest::mt.rawp2adjp(as.numeric(protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$p.value), proc="BH")
fdr.protein.DvI<-fit.protein.DvI$adjp[order(fit.protein.DvI$index),]
protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$FDR <- fdr.protein.DvI[,2]
protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$Sig.FDR.0.1 <- protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$FDR < fdr_thresh_DvI


fdr_thresh_HvL <- 0.01

protein.results.gene.combine.HvL.temp <- inner_join(protein.results.HvL.B1,protein.results.HvL.B2,by="Gene")
protein.results.gene.combine.HvL <- protein.results.gene.combine.HvL.temp |>
  select(Gene,Beta.x,SE_Beta.x,Beta.y,SE_Beta.y)
n.gene.protein.HvL <- dim(protein.results.gene.combine.HvL)[1]

protein.meta.analysis.list.HvL <- list()
protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL <- matrix(NA,nrow = n.gene.protein.HvL,ncol = 6)
dimnames(protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL)[[2]] <- c("Gene","Estimate","SE","Lower.CI","Upper.CI","p.value")
protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[,1] <- protein.results.gene.combine.HvL$Gene
for(j in 1:n.gene.protein.HvL){
  y <- c(protein.results.gene.combine.HvL$Beta.x[j],protein.results.gene.combine.HvL$Beta.y[j])
  se <- c(protein.results.gene.combine.HvL$SE_Beta.x[j],protein.results.gene.combine.HvL$SE_Beta.y[j])
  meta.res.protein.HvL <- rma(yi = y, sei = se,method = "FE")
  protein.meta.analysis.list.HvL[[j]] <- meta.res.protein.HvL
  protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,2] <- meta.res.protein.HvL$beta[1]
  protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,3] <- meta.res.protein.HvL$se
  protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,4] <- meta.res.protein.HvL$ci.lb
  protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,5] <- meta.res.protein.HvL$ci.ub
  protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[j,6] <- meta.res.protein.HvL$pval
}
protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL <- as.data.frame(protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL)

fit.protein.HvL<-multtest::mt.rawp2adjp(as.numeric(protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL$p.value), proc="BH")
fdr.protein.HvL<-fit.protein.HvL$adjp[order(fit.protein.HvL$index),]
protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL$FDR <- fdr.protein.HvL[,2]
protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL$Sig.FDR.0.01 <- protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL$FDR < fdr_thresh_HvL



tmp2<-list(protein.results.DvI.B1, protein.results.DvI.B2, protein.results.HvL.B1,
           protein.results.HvL.B2, protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI, protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL)

names(tmp2)<-c("Protein.DCISvIDC.Batch.1", "Protein.DCISvIDC.Batch.2", "Protein.DCIS.HighvLow.Batch.1", "Protein.DCIS.HighvLow.Batch.2",
               "Protein.DCISvIDC.Meta", "Protein.DCIS.HighvLow.Meta")

write.xlsx(tmp2, rowNames=FALSE, "W:/Health Services and Outcomes Research/BEC/Brooke Fridley/consult/Cheng.Nikki/R01 DCIS/results/Chase_Results/Protein_Meta_analysis_CS.xlsx")

```



```{r meta_pvalues, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}

protein.DvI.meta.pval.temp1 <- inner_join(protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI,protein.LM.results.DvI.B1,by="Gene")
```

## Forest Plots and Boxplots for Protein: DCIS vs IDC (top genes)

5 genes from the protein DCIS vs IDC meta analysis had FDR values < 0.1 from the fixed effects model. In the Excel file, there is a "True/False" indicator column. 

```{r proteinDvIforestplots, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10}

## Forest Plots and Boxplots

protein.DvI.meta.analysis.results.top <- as.numeric(rownames(protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$FDR < fdr_thresh_DvI,]))
n.protein.DvI.top <- length(protein.DvI.meta.analysis.results.top)

for(t in 1:n.protein.DvI.top){
  forest(protein.meta.analysis.list.DvI[[protein.DvI.meta.analysis.results.top[t]]],
         slab = c("Batch 1","Batch 2"),
         header = paste0("Protein DCIS vs IDC - ",protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$Gene[protein.DvI.meta.analysis.results.top[t]]),
         shade = TRUE)
  gene <- protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI[protein.DvI.meta.analysis.results.top[t],]$Gene
  gene_dat <- c(data.trans.protein.DvI.B1[,gene],data.trans.protein.DvI.B2[,gene])
  gene_group <- c(data.trans.protein.DvI.B1$group,data.trans.protein.DvI.B2$group)
  gene_batch <- rep(c("Batch1","Batch2"),each=c(dim(data.trans.protein.DvI.B1)[1],dim(data.trans.protein.DvI.B2)[1]))
  df_gene <- data.frame(gene_dat,gene_group,gene_batch)
  plot1<-ggplot(data=df_gene, aes(x=interaction(gene_group,gene_batch), df_gene[,1], fill = gene_group))+
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA)+
        geom_jitter(color="black")+
        xlab("Group & Batch")+
        ylab("Normalized-Standardized Abundance")+
        scale_fill_discrete(name = "Group") +
        ggtitle(paste0("Protein DCIS vs IDC - ",protein.meta.analysis.results.DvI$Gene[protein.DvI.meta.analysis.results.top[t]]))+
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size=10))

  print(plot1)
}


```


## Forest Plots and Boxplots for Protein: DCIS High vs DCIS Low (top genes)

151 genes from the protein DCIS High vs DCIS Low meta analysis had FDR values < 0.01 from the fixed effects model. In the Excel file, there is a "True/False" indicator column.

```{r icmsforestplots, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10}

protein.HvL.meta.analysis.results.top <- as.numeric(rownames(protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL$FDR < fdr_thresh_HvL,]))
n.protein.HvL.top <- length(protein.HvL.meta.analysis.results.top)

for(t in 1:n.protein.HvL.top){
  forest(protein.meta.analysis.list.HvL[[protein.HvL.meta.analysis.results.top[t]]],
         slab = c("Batch 1","Batch 2"),
         header = paste0("Protein DCIS High vs DCIS Low - ",protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL$Gene[protein.HvL.meta.analysis.results.top[t]]),
         shade = TRUE)
  gene <- protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL[protein.HvL.meta.analysis.results.top[t],]$Gene
  gene_dat <- c(data.trans.protein.HvL.B1[,gene],data.trans.protein.HvL.B2[,gene])
  gene_group <- c(data.trans.protein.HvL.B1$group,data.trans.protein.HvL.B2$group)
  gene_batch <- rep(c("Batch1","Batch2"),each=c(dim(data.trans.protein.HvL.B1)[1],dim(data.trans.protein.HvL.B2)[1]))
  df_gene <- data.frame(gene_dat,gene_group,gene_batch)
  plot1<-ggplot(data=df_gene, aes(x=interaction(gene_group,gene_batch), df_gene[,1], fill = gene_group))+
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA)+
        geom_jitter(color="black")+
        xlab("Group & Batch")+
        ylab("Normalized-Standardized Abundance")+
        scale_fill_discrete(name = "Group") +
        ggtitle(paste0("Protein DCIS High vs DCIS Low - ",protein.meta.analysis.results.HvL$Gene[protein.HvL.meta.analysis.results.top[t]]))+
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size=10))

  print(plot1)
}
```
